title: Walter Gropius
body: Walter Adolph Georg Gropius (18 May 1883 – 5 July 1969) was a Germanarchitect and founder of the Bauhaus School, who, along with Ludwig Mies van der Rohe, Le Corbusier and Frank Lloyd Wright, is widely regarded as one of the pioneering masters of modern architecture.
subtitle: Founder of the Bauhaus School
